recipe.title: Discipline Landscape
recipe.purpose: Map a discipline by methods, subfields, styles, or problem-solving orientations.
recipe.groupingLogic: Groups should reveal how the discipline is internally organized and how its major methods differ.
recipe.contributorRules: Contributors should be included when they exemplify or institutionalize a method or subfield.
recipe.generationInstructions: Prefer categories useful for learning the discipline over encyclopedia taxonomy. Make the map navigable.
evaluationCriteria: Categories help users learn the field
